question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Lucid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Confusing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lucid"** means something that is clear, easy to understand, or transparent in thought. (स्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example:** His explanation of the concept was so lucid that everyone understood it immediately.
 
 
 
• **"Confusing"** is the antonym of "Lucid." It refers to something that is unclear, difficult to understand, or causes confusion. (उलझनभरा)
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were so confusing that nobody could follow them correctly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Lucid'** is **'Confusing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Confusing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Clear** (स्पष्ट): Something that is easy to see, understand, or free from ambiguity.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher gave a clear explanation of the topic.
 
 
 
• **Bright** (चमकीला): Something that emits a lot of light or has a vivid appearance.
 
 
• **Example:** The bright sunlight made it hard to see the road.
 
 
 
• **Fluent** (प्रवाहपूर्ण): Refers to someone or something capable of expressing themselves easily and articulately.
 
 
• **Example:** She is fluent in multiple languages.
